name: Newton
summary: Food-centre gravity and NSL/DTL adjacency — mid-town condo living with evening queues as the lifestyle tax.
body: Newton is the shortlist when food-centre reputation and dual-line optionality matter more than medical-hub density. Condo stock along the CTE / Newton corridor trades quieter blocks for weekend food queues and tourist spill from the famous centre. Expats shortlist it for CBD hops without full Orchard mall intensity. Watch-outs: evening noise near the food centre, older vs newer tower variance, and estate-specific fire-alarm recovery rules. Compare with Novena for hospital convenience, Toa Payoh Central for heartland errands, and Upper Thomson when reservoir weekends beat mid-town food crowds.
bestFor: people testing ActiveSG yoga nearby before paying for condo studios
watchOuts: False-alarm / detector ops vary by MCST
housingMix: Condo-dominant with selective landed pockets toward the north.
commuteNotes: North-South Line and Downtown Line at Newton; test a Saturday evening walk before you romanticise the food strip.
